cues.en: Welcome to the theater of magic.
cues.zh: 欢迎来到魔幻剧场。

cues.en: I love
cues.zh: 我超爱

cues.en: pinball.
cues.zh: 弹珠台。

cues.en: The sights, the sounds,
cues.zh: 炫目的灯光、音效，

cues.en: the physical nature of actual stuff happening in front of you and not just on a video screen have long appealed to me.
cues.zh: 还有眼前真实发生的物理碰撞，而非单纯屏幕上的画面，一直以来都深深吸引着我。

cues.en: In fact, for as long as I can remember.
cues.zh: 事实上，从我有记忆起就一直如此。

cues.en: Of course, a big draw to me is that these machines are,
cues.zh: 当然，最吸引我的一点还在于，这些设备……

cues.en: well, machines,
cues.zh: 嗯，本身就是纯粹的机械，

cues.en: and wondrous machines at that.
cues.zh: 而且是精妙绝伦的机械。

cues.en: A pinball machine is a fascinating tribute to humanity.
cues.zh: 一台弹珠机，是对人类创造力的美妙致敬。

cues.en: Artists, musicians, game designers, and even voice actors work alongside machinists,
cues.zh: 艺术家、音乐家、游戏设计师，甚至配音演员，与机械师、

cues.en: fabricators,
cues.zh: 装配工、

cues.en: craftspeople,
cues.zh: 工匠，

cues.en: and engineers
cues.zh: 以及工程师们并肩合作，

cues.en: to manufacture these
cues.zh: 共同打造出这些

cues.en: elaborate contraptions
cues.zh: 精巧的机械装置，

cues.en: made purely for our amusement.
cues.zh: 纯粹为了博我们一笑。

cues.en: Well,
cues.zh: 呃，

cues.en: and to gobble up our quarters.
cues.zh: 顺便吞掉我们口袋里的硬币。

cues.en: With so much going on inside one of these, even just sitting idle,
cues.zh: 哪怕只是静静待机，里面也有如此繁复的运作，

cues.en: you might have wondered how they work.
cues.zh: 你或许也好奇过它们到底是如何工作的。

cues.en: Luckily,
cues.zh: 幸运的是，

cues.en: somebody gave me the keys to this machine so we can look inside.
cues.zh: 有人给了我这台机器的钥匙，我们可以拆开看看里面。

cues.en: It's
cues.zh: 这是……

cues.en: it's a computer.
cues.zh: 这其实是一台电脑。

cues.en: There's a computer in here. It keeps track of where the ball is, shows you your score on this display, plays music and sound effects through speakers,
cues.zh: 这里面有一台电脑。它负责追踪球的位置、在显示屏上显示得分、通过扬声器播放音乐和音效，

cues.en: and lights up all the various light bulbs when they need to be lit.
cues.zh: 并在适当时机点亮各种指示灯泡。

cues.en: How very modern.
cues.zh: 相当现代化。

cues.en: But pinball goes back much further than this.
cues.zh: 但弹珠台的历史远不止于此。

cues.en: And not even twenty years prior to this machine leaving the factory,
cues.zh: 在这台机器出厂前不到二十年的时间里，

cues.en: pinball machines didn't feature any integrated circuits of any kind.
cues.zh: 弹珠机上根本没有任何形式的集成电路。

cues.en: This is Aztec by Williams.
cues.zh: 这是 Williams 生产的 Aztec。

cues.en: Built in 1976,
cues.zh: 制造于 1976 年，

cues.en: this machine hails from the tail end of the electromechanical
cues.zh: 这台机器出自机电时代

cues.en: era.
cues.zh: 的尾声。

cues.en: It wouldn't be long before manufacturers
cues.zh: 没过多久，制造商们

cues.en: started tinkering with electronic controls.
cues.zh: 就开始尝试电子控制了。

cues.en: In fact, 10 copies of this very game were built as prototypes for the Williams System two microprocessor
cues.zh: 事实上，这款游戏曾生产过 10 台原型机，用来测试 Williams System 2 微处理器

cues.en: unit.
cues.zh: 单元。

cues.en: This one though, well, it's a little more old school. And today, I'm gonna show you what makes it tick.
cues.zh: 不过眼下这台嘛，要更复古一些。今天，我就带大家看看它是怎么运转的。

cues.en: Seriously, why is it ticking?
cues.zh: 说真的，它为什么一直在“滴答”响？

cues.en: To find out, we'll have to look inside.
cues.zh: 想弄明白，我们得看看里面。

cues.en: This time it opens from the back, and once you remove this panel you won't see anything that looks like a computer. In fact, you'll find an unholy mess of wires linking quite the assortment of oddball assemblies together.
cues.zh: 这台得从背面打开，取下这块盖板后，你看不到任何像电脑的东西。相反，你会看到一团乱麻般的电线，把各种稀奇古怪的组件串联在一起。

cues.en: And this isn't even the half of it. Inside the main cabinet under the playfield,
cues.zh: 而这还只是冰山一角。在台面下方的主机箱里，

cues.en: there's even more.
cues.zh: 还有更多部件。

cues.en: We get in there by opening the coin door, pulling this lever which releases the lockdown bar, that's this large metal piece at the front edge of the cabinet, then once we remove the lockdown bar by lifting up on it we can slide the glass out and the playfield will simply lift right up. There's even a handy prop rod.
cues.zh: 我们先打开投币门，拉动这个释放压条的拉杆——也就是机箱前端这块大金属压条，把它向上抬起取下后，就能抽出玻璃面板，游戏台面也可以直接抬起来了。这里甚至配了一根方便的支撑杆。

cues.en: Now that we're in, we see even more wires and even more stuff.
cues.zh: 现在打开了，能看到更多的电线和零件。

cues.en: And that's not even the whole of it. Some of the control mechanisms are attached to the underside of the playfield.
cues.zh: 而且这还不是全部。很多控制机构其实都装在游戏台面的背面。

cues.en: Each and every one of these devices is critical for the function and logic of this game.
cues.zh: 这些装置中的每一个都对这款游戏的功能和逻辑至关重要。

cues.en: While this is nowhere near as complex as Theater of Magic,
cues.zh: 虽然这远没有 Theater of Magic 那么复杂，

cues.en: there's still a lot going on. There's a full on rule set and series of goals in this game, Different targets light the letters A, Z, T, E, and C.
cues.zh: 但仍然有很多机制。游戏有一套完整的规则和一系列目标，不同的目标会点亮字母 A、Z、T、E、C。

cues.en: Light them all up and there's a chance for an extra ball. There's a bonus added for hitting certain targets which is awarded at the end of each ball, and if you hit the right targets you can double the bonus value.
cues.zh: 全部点亮就有机会获得额外球。击中某些目标会累积奖励，并在每球结束时发放；击中正确的目标还能让奖励值翻倍。

cues.en: There's more too. If you complete Aztec and fill the bonus ladder up to 50,000 points, that lights a special which awards a free game.
cues.zh: 还有更多。如果你完成 Aztec 并把奖励阶梯填到 50,000 分，就会点亮一个特殊奖励，奖励一局免费游戏。

cues.en: And which out lane is lit will flip back and forth as you hit other targets.
cues.zh: 而且，当你击中其他目标时，亮起的是哪条外侧球道会来回切换。

cues.en: You can also win replays based on your score,
cues.zh: 你还可以根据得分赢得重玩机会，

cues.en: and that's configurable.
cues.zh: 而且这是可配置的。

cues.en: Some of the rules can even be changed. Winning a special can award an extra ball instead of a replay,
cues.zh: 有些规则甚至可以更改。赢得特殊奖励可以奖励额外球，而不是重玩机会，

cues.en: and there are even three difficulty settings which change how many targets need to be hit before other opportunities are awarded.
cues.zh: 甚至还有三档难度设置，会改变在获得其他机会前需要击中多少目标。

cues.en: But aside from rules and features,
cues.zh: 但除了规则和功能之外，

cues.en: the machine also needs to keep track of which ball is in play and thus how far you are along the game. Oh, and by the way, you can choose whether you want three balls per game or five.
cues.zh: 机器还需要跟踪当前进行的是哪颗球，从而知道你游戏进行到哪一步。哦对了，你还可以选择每局三颗球还是五颗球。

cues.en: It has to end the game when it's over and disable the playfield,
cues.zh: 游戏结束时它必须结束本局并禁用台面，

cues.en: and when a new one is started it needs to reset the scores to zero.
cues.zh: 而当新一局开始时，它需要把分数重置为零。

cues.en: Plus, up to four people can play this game. It's fun to compete.
cues.zh: 另外，这款游戏最多支持四人游玩。竞争很有趣。

cues.en: So it needs to keep track of which player is up and only change that player's score when it's their turn.
cues.zh: 所以它需要跟踪轮到哪位玩家，并且只在该玩家回合时改变其分数。

cues.en: Somehow,
cues.zh: 不知怎么，

cues.en: that's all being accomplished with
cues.zh: 这一切都是靠

cues.en: this rat's nest of wires and stuff.
cues.zh: 这团乱七八糟的电线和东西完成的。

cues.en: How?
cues.zh: 怎么做到的？

cues.en: Why, it's easy. Just look at the schematic. I'm sure you can figure it out.
cues.zh: 哎呀，很简单。看看原理图就知道了。我保证你能看明白。

cues.en: I'm kidding, of course. And even if you studied this for hours, it's not gonna make any sense unless you understand what these parts are doing and how they work together.
cues.zh: 当然，我是在开玩笑。即使你研究上几个小时，除非你理解这些部件在做什么以及它们如何协同工作，否则也毫无意义。

cues.en: So, since you're all watching,
cues.zh: 所以，既然你们都在看，

cues.en: I suppose it's my job to explain what these parts are doing and how they work together.
cues.zh: 我想我的工作就是解释这些部件在做什么，以及它们如何协同工作。

cues.en: We'll start with the basics and work our way up.
cues.zh: 我们会从基础开始，逐步深入。

cues.en: And we're gonna go way back to basics with a bit of history.
cues.zh: 而且我们要回到最基础的地方，讲一点历史。

cues.en: But just a bit, I promise.
cues.zh: 但就一点点，我保证。

cues.en: Pinball is called pinball because in the earliest days it was a simple game of balls and pins.
cues.zh: 弹球机之所以叫 pinball，是因为最早它就是一个由球和钉子组成的简单游戏。

cues.en: An evolution of the French game bagatelle,
cues.zh: 它是法国游戏 bagatelle 的演变，

cues.en: early games were very simple. Marbles rolled down a board set at an angle with pins nailed into the face.
cues.zh: 早期的游戏非常简单。弹珠沿着倾斜的板子滚下，板面上钉着钉子。

cues.en: Those pins would create obstacles that deflected the motion of the rolling balls and would often form goals worth points.
cues.zh: 那些钉子会形成障碍，改变滚球的运动方向，还常常组成有分数的目标。

cues.en: Games like this were made going back to the eighteenth century,
cues.zh: 这类游戏可以追溯到十八世纪，

cues.en: but they would remain obscure toys for the wealthy for many years.
cues.zh: 但很多年里，它们一直只是富人玩的冷门玩具。

cues.en: Then, sometime around the great depression, some clever folks devised ways to automate the game and turn it into a machine, albeit a very simple one.
cues.zh: 后来，大约在大萧条时期，一些聪明人想出了让游戏自动化的方法，把它变成一台机器，虽然只是一台非常简单的机器。

cues.en: David Gottlieb designed Baffleball in 1931,
cues.zh: David Gottlieb 在1931年设计了 Baffleball，

cues.en: which is widely regarded as the first commercially successful pinball game.
cues.zh: 它被广泛认为是第一款商业上成功的弹珠机。

cues.en: I don't have one to show you, but I do have Microsoft Pinball Arcade.
cues.zh: 我没有实物可以展示，但我有 Microsoft Pinball Arcade。

cues.en: Baffleball was a simple baseball themed, I guess, marble game with the twist of being coin operated.
cues.zh: Baffleball 是一款简单的棒球主题弹珠游戏——我猜是吧——特别之处是投币操作。

cues.en: When the coin slide was pushed in, trap doors in the goals would open allowing the balls to fall down into the machine and collect at the ball shooter.
cues.zh: 当投币滑道被推入时，球门处的活门会打开，让球落入机器，并聚集到发射器处。

cues.en: Then the player had their fun.
cues.zh: 然后玩家就可以尽情玩耍了。

cues.en: These early games were purely mechanical, featured manual scoring, were meant to go atop a table or other such surface,
cues.zh: 这些早期机器纯机械，采用手动计分，原本要放在桌子或其他类似表面上，

cues.en: and started showing up in bars and parlors all across the country.
cues.zh: 并开始出现在全国各地的酒吧和娱乐厅里。

cues.en: And plenty of gambling based on your score occurred too, but that's a story for a different time.
cues.zh: 而且还会出现大量根据你的得分进行的赌博，不过那是另一个时代的故事了。

cues.en: Baffleball was so successful that it spawned plenty of imitators,
cues.zh: Baffleball 如此成功，以至于催生了许多模仿者，

cues.en: such as Ballyhoo,
cues.zh: 比如 Ballyhoo，

cues.en: which by the way was so successful that the company that produced it would rename itself Bally.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，Ballyhoo 非常成功，以至于生产它的公司把自己改名成了 Bally。

cues.en: With a variety of games for players to choose from, companies making pinball machines scrambled to add new features in order to make theirs stand out.
cues.zh: 随着玩家可选择的游戏越来越多，弹珠机制造公司争相添加新功能，好让自己的产品脱颖而出。

cues.en: Features like bumpers, electric lights, automatic scoring, and eventually
cues.zh: 比如缓冲器、电灯、自动计分，最终还有

cues.en: movable bumpers in the player's control.
cues.zh: 由玩家控制的移动缓冲器。

cues.en: It was none other than D. Gottlieb and Co that introduced electromechanical
cues.zh: 正是 D. Gottlieb and Co 推出了机电式

cues.en: flippers in nineteen forty seven's Humpty Dumpty.
cues.zh: 挡板，用于1947年的 Humpty Dumpty。

cues.en: While the arrangement of the flippers on the playfield is certainly
cues.zh: 虽然挡板在台面上的布局确实

cues.en: odd by modern tastes,
cues.zh: 按现代审美来看很奇怪，

cues.en: this machine set new and enduring standards for pinball.
cues.zh: 这台机器为弹珠机树立了新的、持久的标准。

cues.en: And twenty nine years later, one of Gottlieb's main rivals, Williams, would release this machine.
cues.zh: 二十九年之后，Gottlieb 的主要竞争对手之一 Williams 发布了这台机器。

cues.en: Aztec.
cues.zh: Aztec。

cues.en: The one I'm standing behind and that this video is principally about. That one.
cues.zh: 就是我站在它后面的这台，也是本视频主要介绍的那台。就是这台。

cues.en: First, let's look at what the player sees.
cues.zh: 首先，我们来看看玩家看到的内容。

cues.en: The playfield is still just a wooden board with things attached to it that a ball rolls around on, but now a variety of targets, obstacles, bumpers, plenty of lights, and let's not forget flippers
cues.zh: 台面仍然只是一块木板，上面装着各种东西，球在上面滚动，但现在有各种目标、障碍物、缓冲器、大量灯光，别忘了还有挡板

cues.en: make the game fast paced, visually interesting,
cues.zh: 让游戏节奏明快、视觉上很有趣，

cues.en: and addictive.
cues.zh: 而且令人上瘾。

cues.en: As with most pinball machines, the playfield is slightly off center as the right hand side of the machine is taken up by the shooter lane. That sends the ball up to the top of the playfield using a player operated plunger,
cues.zh: 和大多数弹珠机一样，台面略微偏离中心，因为机器右侧被发射通道占据。发射通道通过玩家操作的发射杆把球送到台面顶部，

cues.en: just like the earliest games.
cues.zh: 就像最早的那些游戏一样。

cues.en: A simple gauge is printed on the shooter to help the player hit the ball with consistent force.
cues.zh: 发射器上印有一个简单的力度标尺，帮助玩家以稳定的力度发射球。

cues.en: Depending on the game's design, the strength of the initial plunge may be important,
cues.zh: 根据游戏设计，初始发射的力度可能很重要，

cues.en: and many games feature a deliberate element known as a skill shot where extra points are awarded if you get the plunge strength just right.
cues.zh: 许多游戏还设有刻意设计的要素，叫作技巧射球：如果你把发射力度控制得刚刚好，就会获得额外分数。

cues.en: Now you'll notice that there are fairly large obstacles which block off parts of the playfield.
cues.zh: 你会注意到台面上有几个比较大的障碍物，挡住了部分区域。

cues.en: This is done mainly to define paths the ball might or, in some cases, must take.
cues.zh: 这样做主要是为了规划球可能走、或者某些情况下必须走的路线。

cues.en: These can be created in a number of ways, but the most common is plastic posts fastened to the playfield which are then fitted with rubber rings.
cues.zh: 制作这些障碍物的方法有很多，但最常见的是在台面上固定塑料立柱，再套上橡胶圈。

cues.en: Large rings may be stretched across two or more posts to create a linear barrier,
cues.zh: 大胶圈可以跨套在两个或更多立柱上，形成一道线性屏障，

cues.en: but you'll find plenty of individual posts with their own rings too.
cues.zh: 但你也会看到很多套着独立胶圈的单根立柱。

cues.en: The rubber rings make the ball bounce off these obstacles often unpredictably,
cues.zh: 橡胶圈会让球在撞击这些障碍物后产生难以预测的反弹，

cues.en: and some of the larger barriers will award 10 points when hit.
cues.zh: 击中部分较大的屏障还会获得 10 分。

cues.en: To fill the otherwise blank areas of the playfield created by the obstacles,
cues.zh: 为了填补障碍物在台面上留下的空白区域，

cues.en: decorative plastic pieces printed with graphics matching the game's theme are placed atop the posts.
cues.zh: 立柱顶端会装上印有游戏主题图案的装饰塑料片。

cues.en: This also helps visually define the shape of the off limits areas.
cues.zh: 这在视觉上也有助于标出球无法进入的区域。

cues.en: Underneath the plastics you'll find small incandescent light bulbs.
cues.zh: 在这些塑料片下方，你会看到小颗白炽灯泡。

cues.en: This is the only safe place to put them since the ball can't hit them, and they illuminate the playfield to allow for play in a dark room.
cues.zh: 这是唯一能安全放置灯泡的地方，球撞不到它们，而且还能照亮台面，方便在暗室中游玩。

cues.en: All things considered,
cues.zh: 总的来说，

cues.en: this is a pretty simple layout with a small number and variety of targets.
cues.zh: 这里的布局相当简单，目标的数量和种类都比较少。

cues.en: Aside from the various 10 bumpers,
cues.zh: 除了各种 10 分缓冲器之外，

cues.en: this game features three rollover buttons,
cues.zh: 这款游戏还有三个滚过按钮、

cues.en: eight rollover lanes,
cues.zh: 八条滚过通道、

cues.en: six stand up targets, one spinning target, one kickback lane, two slingshot kickers,
cues.zh: 六个直立靶、一个旋转靶、一条反弹通道、两个弹弓击打器，

cues.en: and three pop bumpers
cues.zh: 以及三个弹跳缓冲器。

cues.en: All of these award points when they're hit, but they often do something else too or change how many points they award.
cues.zh: 击中这些机关都会得分，但通常还会触发其他机制，或者改变所奖励的分数。

cues.en: But for now, let's just focus on the points.
cues.zh: 不过现在，我们先只关注分数。

cues.en: The game shows you your score on the back glass with these mechanical readouts called score reels.
cues.zh: 游戏会通过后玻璃上名为“记分鼓轮”的机械读数器来显示得分。

cues.en: Oh, by the way, this back glass isn't in very good shape, but I've got a reproduction replacement.
cues.zh: 顺便提一下，这块后玻璃磨损比较严重，但我买了个复刻替换件。

cues.en: I've just not gotten around to ordering the right piece of glass for it yet. Anyway,
cues.zh: 只是我还没来得及为它订购合适尺寸的玻璃。总之，

cues.en: see if you can spot a fun little trick manufacturers
cues.zh: 看看你能不能发现当年制造商

cues.en: were doing around this time.
cues.zh: 玩的一个有趣的小把戏。

cues.en: Look at the front,
cues.zh: 先看正面，

cues.en: and now the back.
cues.zh: 再看背面。

cues.en: Do you see what's off? Look at the front again.
cues.zh: 看出哪里不对劲了吗？再看一眼正面。

cues.en: There are six digits in the score,
cues.zh: 分数一共有六位数，

cues.en: but look at the back and there are only five score reels per player.
cues.zh: 但看背面，每个玩家其实只有五个记分鼓轮。

cues.en: The last digit of the readout is in fact fake,
cues.zh: 读数上的最后一位其实是假的，

cues.en: and is only there to inflate the score.
cues.zh: 纯粹是为了让分数看起来更高。

cues.en: But Williams went through the trouble of printing the bottom of the nine and the top of the one on the dummy reel, which makes it quite convincing.
cues.zh: 但 Williams 还费了番心思，在假轮上印了数字 9 的下半部分和数字 1 的上半部分，做足以假乱真。

cues.en: Here's a spare score reel, or drum unit as Williams calls it, we can look at up close.
cues.zh: 这儿有一个备用的记分鼓轮——Williams 称之为 drum unit——我们可以近距离看一下。

cues.en: It's a fairly simple device, just a large plastic drum with the digits zero through nine printed on its edge and a ratcheting mechanism to advance the position of the drum by one tenth of a rotation.
cues.zh: 它的结构相当简单，就是一个大塑料滚筒，边缘印着数字 0 到 9，配有一个棘轮机构，每次让滚筒推进十分之一圈。

cues.en: A small solenoid, a type of electromagnet,
cues.zh: 一个小型螺线管，一种电磁铁，

cues.en: pulls on a plunger when electric current runs through it, and that advances the mechanism by one step.
cues.zh: 电流通过时会拉动一个柱塞，从而让机构前进一格。

cues.en: By the way, I hope you like electromagnets
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，希望你喜欢电磁铁

cues.en: because this machine is chock full of them.
cues.zh: 因为这台机器里到处都是它们。

cues.en: The game's circuitry runs on 24 volts AC produced by this lump of a transformer sitting in the bottom which also produces six volts for all the lamps.
cues.zh: 游戏的电路使用底部这一大块变压器产生的 24 伏交流电运行，它还为所有灯提供 6 伏电压。

cues.en: All of the targets the ball can hit that award points are merely simple switches.
cues.zh: 球能击中并得分的所有目标，其实都只是简单的开关。

cues.en: When the game is on and in play, those switches become wired to the scoring mechanism.
cues.zh: 游戏开启并运行时，这些开关就会接入计分机构。

cues.en: Take these 100
cues.zh: 看看这些 100

cues.en: rollover buttons for example.
cues.zh: 个滚过按钮为例。

cues.en: They literally are buttons, and beneath the play field two electrical contacts become pressed together when the button is depressed by the weight of the ball.
cues.zh: 它们真的就是按钮，当球压下按钮时，台面下方的两个电触点会被压到一起。

cues.en: You might guess that these 100 buttons are wired to the score reel in the hundreds position,
cues.zh: 你可能会猜，这 100 个按钮接到百位上的计分轮，

cues.en: and sure enough when I press it that reel advances by one step.
cues.zh: 果然，我按下它时，那个计分轮前进一格。

cues.en: But that's not all that happened. A bell rang at the same time.
cues.zh: 但发生的还不止这些。与此同时，一只铃响了。

cues.en: Sitting in the cabinet near the coin door is the chime unit.
cues.zh: 投币门附近的机箱里装有音钟组件。

cues.en: This is a unit with chimes.
cues.zh: 这是一个带音钟的组件。

cues.en: Each of its three chimes has a solenoid sitting below it, and when power is sent to the coil it flings a plunger up into the chime which gives it a right smack.
cues.zh: 它的三个音钟各自下方都有一个电磁铁，通电时会把柱塞向上弹进音钟，重重敲一下。

cues.en: That
cues.zh: 那

cues.en: certainly rings a bell.
cues.zh: 确实敲响了铃。

cues.en: Since two solenoids were fired with one switch,
cues.zh: 既然一个开关触发了两个电磁铁，

cues.en: solenoids that draw a lot of current and are located in two very different places,
cues.zh: 这些电磁铁耗电大，而且位于两个完全不同的地方，

cues.en: the switch on the playfield isn't what's powering them.
cues.zh: 那么台面上的开关并不是直接给它们供电的。

cues.en: Instead, the playfield switch powers a relay,
cues.zh: 相反，台面开关给一个继电器供电，

cues.en: specifically the 100
cues.zh: 具体来说就是 100

cues.en: relay which lives in the backbox.
cues.zh: 继电器，它位于背箱里。

cues.en: Relays are switches that are actuated with, wait for it,
cues.zh: 继电器是靠一种东西驱动的开关，等等——

cues.en: an electromagnet.
cues.zh: 电磁铁。

cues.en: A coil of wire creates a magnetic field when it's energized which pulls on an armature and that in turn actuates a series of switches.
cues.zh: 线圈通电时会产生磁场，拉动衔铁，进而驱动一组开关。

cues.en: Sometimes relays are simple, and sometimes they're not. In pinball machines like this, they're not.
cues.zh: 有时继电器很简单，有时并不简单。像这种弹珠机里，它们就不简单。

cues.en: Pinball pushes relays to their conceptual limit, using them to create the game logic and do countless other tasks,
cues.zh: 弹珠机把继电器的概念发挥到极限，用它们实现游戏逻辑并完成无数其他任务，

cues.en: but that's a big part of why I like these machines so much.
cues.zh: 而这正是我如此喜欢这些机器的很大原因。

cues.en: Notice that some of these switches are normally open and the contacts close when the relay is energized,
cues.zh: 注意，有些开关是常开的，继电器通电时触点闭合，

cues.en: but some of them are just the opposite.
cues.zh: 但有些正好相反。

cues.en: There's even a third option, make brake switches.
cues.zh: 甚至还有第三种，通断开关。

cues.en: We'll see some of those later.
cues.zh: 后面我们会看到其中一些。

cues.en: In this case, the switch on the playfield, since it was worth 100 points, completed a circuit to energize the 100 relay.
cues.zh: 在这里，台面上的开关因为值 100 分，接通了给 100 继电器通电的电路。

cues.en: When that pulled on its armature,
cues.zh: 当它拉动衔铁时，

cues.en: these two switch contacts closed which completed a circuit both to the hundredth position score reel and the small chime.
cues.zh: 这两个开关触点闭合，接通了通往百位计分轮和小音钟的电路。

cues.en: All of the targets worth 100 points have their switches wired in parallel so that they'll all activate this relay when hit.
cues.zh: 所有值 100 分的目标，其开关都并联在一起，所以被击中时都会激活这个继电器。

cues.en: And all that arcing we see is precisely why the game uses a relay and not the switches on the playfield.
cues.zh: 我们看到的这些电弧，正是这台机器使用继电器而不是台面开关的原因。

cues.en: Seems simple enough, but there are many more switches on this relay than just the two that bump the score reel and chime.
cues.zh: 看起来挺简单，但这个继电器上的开关远不止推动计分轮和报鸣器的那两个。

cues.en: In fact, there are six.
cues.zh: 实际上，它有六个。

cues.en: One of these additional switches is there to ensure the score reel actually moves.
cues.zh: 其中一个多出来的开关，就是用来确保计分轮确实转动了。

cues.en: Solenoids are fast but they're not instantaneous.
cues.zh: 电磁铁动作很快，但并不是瞬间完成的。

cues.en: If the ball just brushes up against a target, the contact time may have been too brief for the solenoid in the score reel to pull completely on the plunger and actually advance it to the next number.
cues.zh: 如果球只是轻轻蹭了一下目标，接触时间可能太短，不足以让计分轮里的电磁铁完全拉动柱塞跳到下一个数字。

cues.en: So, these two contacts
cues.zh: 所以，这两个触点

cues.en: actually provide a way for the relay to power itself.
cues.zh: 实际上为继电器提供了一种自供电回路。

cues.en: If I bridge them with a screwdriver,
cues.zh: 如果我用螺丝刀短接它们，

cues.en: you'll see it pull in.
cues.zh: 你就会看到它吸合。

cues.en: On its own, this would be useless.
cues.zh: 光是这样是没用的。

cues.en: The moment any 100 target were hit, the relay would lock itself on and be stuck.
cues.zh: 一旦击中任何 100 分目标，继电器就会锁死并一直卡住。

cues.en: But that circuit path travels through a switch on the score reel called the end of stroke switch.
cues.zh: 但这回路还穿过了计分轮上的一个开关，叫做行程终点开关。

cues.en: This is normally closed allowing power to flow through, but opens once the solenoid has reached the end of its travel.
cues.zh: 它是常闭的，允许电流通过，但一旦电磁铁达到行程终点就会断开。

cues.en: At that point it breaks the circuit powering the relay so the relay lets go.
cues.zh: 此时它切断了继电器的供电，继电器就会释放。

cues.en: Here's what that looks like on the schematic for the machine.
cues.zh: 在机器的原理图上，就是这个样子。

cues.en: Full disclosure,
cues.zh: 事先说明，

cues.en: I've made some alterations to this and hidden a fair bit because some of what's visible here is very confusing without context I haven't given you yet and it's not important right now.
cues.zh: 我对图纸做了一些改动，隐藏了不少内容，因为脱离背景的话有些东西会让人一头雾水，而且眼下也不重要。

cues.en: When reading the schematic,
cues.zh: 看原理图时，

cues.en: power flows across the page and a circuit is active when there's a complete path from the left to the right, though it's AC so it flows in both directions.
cues.zh: 电流横跨图纸流动，只要从左到右形成完整通路，电路就会导通——虽然是交流电，实际上是双向流动的。

cues.en: The 100 relay coil is right here.
cues.zh: 100 分继电器线圈就在这里。

cues.en: It will become energized when any of these switches close.
cues.zh: 只要这些开关中有任何一个闭合，线圈就会通电。

cues.en: They're labeled to indicate what and where they are, and sure enough those are things worth 100 points.
cues.zh: 图上的标签标明了它们是什么以及在什么位置，不出所料，全都是 100 分的部件。

cues.en: But this switch is labeled 100
cues.zh: 但这个开关被标记为 100 分

cues.en: relay.
cues.zh: 继电器。

cues.en: That means it's a switch within that relay, and the symbol means it's a normally open switch.
cues.zh: 这意味着它是该继电器内部的一个开关，符号表示它是一个常开开关。

cues.en: So it closes when the relay energizes,
cues.zh: 因此当继电器通电时，它就会闭合，

cues.en: and since it also provides power to the relay coil,
cues.zh: 又因为它也给继电器线圈供电，

cues.en: it provides that bypass which keeps the coil energized
cues.zh: 就提供了一条旁路回路，让线圈持续保持通电，

cues.en: even when input from the other switches is lost.
cues.zh: 哪怕其他开关的输入已经断开。

cues.en: But that switch is itself wired in series with all of these normally closed switches on the score reels. Those are the end of stroke switches we were just looking at. So once the solenoid on whichever reel it's trying to fire has actually fired,
cues.zh: 但这只开关本身又与计分轮上的所有常闭开关串联。那些就是我们刚才看的行程终点开关。所以只要当前轮上的电磁铁彻底动作到位，

cues.en: the relay will lose that bypass signal and de energize.
cues.zh: 继电器就会失去旁路供电并断电释放。

cues.en: Another contact in the relay has to do with the number nine.
cues.zh: 继电器里的另一个触点则与数字 9 有关。

cues.en: The score reels are not mechanically linked, each one operates entirely independently of the others.
cues.zh: 各计分轮之间没有机械联动，每一个都完全独立运行。

cues.en: But if you have 900 points and score an additional 100,
cues.zh: 但如果你已经有900分，又得了100分，

cues.en: according to the laws of math you'll have 1,000,
cues.zh: 按数学规律，你就有了1000分，

cues.en: so two reels have to move in order to display that sum.
cues.zh: 所以需要转动两个记分轮来显示总分。

cues.en: They do.
cues.zh: 确实转了。

cues.en: And did you notice that two bells rang this time?
cues.zh: 那你注意到这次响了两声铃吗？

cues.en: This switch in the 100 relay will actually cause the 1,000
cues.zh: 100分继电器里的这个开关，其实也会让1000分

cues.en: relay to energize as well, but only when the 100 score reel is on the number nine.
cues.zh: 继电器通电，但前提是百位记分轮停在数字9上。

cues.en: Look back at the score reel and you'll find a stack of switches, which we call a switch stack oddly enough, sitting near the top.
cues.zh: 回头看记分轮，你会发现顶部附近有一组开关，巧的是它就叫叠层开关（switch stack）。

cues.en: This switch is normally open, but a pivoting mechanism actuates the switch stack at the nine position and closes that switch.
cues.zh: 这个开关平时是常开的，但在9的位置上，枢轴机构会触发该开关组，使其闭合。

cues.en: When it's closed,
cues.zh: 闭合之后，

cues.en: an interlock is created between the 100 relay and the 1,000
cues.zh: 100分继电器和1000分

cues.en: relay.
cues.zh: 继电器之间就建立了联锁。

cues.en: Take a look at the schematic again.
cues.zh: 再来看一下原理图。

cues.en: These are the ninth position switches on the score reels, and you'll see that they connect to that switch within the 100 relay.
cues.zh: 这些是记分轮上的“9位”开关，可以看到它们连到了100分继电器内部的那个开关上。

cues.en: If the score reel switch on the player that's up is closed,
cues.zh: 如果当前玩家记分轮上的开关是闭合的，

cues.en: meaning the 100 score reel is showing a nine,
cues.zh: 也就是说百位记分轮正显示9，

cues.en: then the next time the 100 relay fires power will also get sent through to this switch and up to the 1,000
cues.zh: 那么下一次100分继电器动作时，电源也会穿过这个开关送往1000分

cues.en: relay coil,
cues.zh: 继电器线圈，

cues.en: therefore the two relays will fire together.
cues.zh: 两个继电器便会同时动作。

cues.en: All of the succeeding score reels have this interlock,
cues.zh: 后面所有的高位记分轮都有这种联锁机制，

cues.en: so a score of 99,990
will correctly roll to 100,000
cues.zh: 就能正确进位翻转到100,000分，

cues.en: when a single 10 bumper is hit.
cues.zh: 哪怕只是撞击了一次10分弹柱。

cues.en: Speaking of the 10 bumpers, now's a good time to go over the various target types on the playfield.
cues.zh: 说到10分弹柱，正好可以介绍一下台面上的各类目标。

cues.en: When a rubber ring is stretched across two posts, so long as the distance is sufficient,
cues.zh: 当一根橡胶圈套在两个立柱上时，只要间距足够，

cues.en: a switch will be tucked behind that ring.
cues.zh: 橡胶圈后面就会藏一个开关。

cues.en: The contacts are slightly separated but will get pushed together when the ball stretches the ring, sending power to the 10 relay which advances the 10 score reel, rings a bell,
cues.zh: 触点平时稍微分开，但小球拉伸橡胶圈时触点会被压合，给10分继电器供电，从而推进十位记分轮、敲响铃铛，

cues.en: and also steps the number match unit.
cues.zh: 并让数字匹配单元步进一步。

cues.en: Don't worry about that yet.
cues.zh: 先不用管这个。

cues.en: There's a lot going on in here.
cues.zh: 这里的门道还有很多。

cues.en: The stand up targets throughout the playfield are essentially the same thing as all the 10 bumpers,
cues.zh: 台面上分布的立靶跟那些10分弹柱本质上是一样的，

cues.en: but one of the switch contacts is attached to the face of the target.
cues.zh: 只不过其中一个开关触点直接装在靶面上。

cues.en: The gap between the contacts here is important.
cues.zh: 这里的触点间隙非常关键。

cues.en: A wider gap will require the ball to hit the target with more force in order for that hit to register,
cues.zh: 间隙偏大，就需要小球以更大的力量撞击靶子才能计分；

cues.en: but if they're too close simply brushing against the target will register as a hit.
cues.zh: 但如果靠得太近，轻轻擦过靶子就会被判定为击中。

cues.en: So it's generally best to be somewhere in the middle.
cues.zh: 所以调到一个折中的位置通常最合适。

cues.en: The rollover lanes are essentially the same thing as the rollover buttons,
cues.zh: 滚珠通道和滚珠按钮本质上也差不多，

cues.en: but instead of a button a formed piece of wire sticks up through a slot in the playfield.
cues.zh: 只不过这里不是按钮，而是一根成型的金属丝从台面的开槽中探出来。

cues.en: When that wire is depressed by the ball, switch contacts below the playfield are pushed together which adds the points.
cues.zh: 当金属丝被小球压下时，台面下方的开关触点被压紧闭合，从而完成加分。

cues.en: Generally the ball can travel over these in either direction,
cues.zh: 通常小球可以双向滚过这些通道，

cues.en: but you'll notice that the designers had an evil streak with the out lanes.
cues.zh: 但你会发现，设计师在外侧出球通道上其实使了点坏心思。

cues.en: Those have their trip wires formed such that it will only allow the ball to travel down towards the drain.
cues.zh: 这些单向钢丝的形状经过特殊设计，只允许球朝落球口的方向向下滚。

cues.en: Should you happen to get very lucky and have the ball bounce off the apron and roll up the out lane, which does happen occasionally,
cues.zh: 如果你运气极好，球从挡板弹起并逆向冲上外侧轨道——这种情况确实偶尔会发生——

cues.en: unless it's going very fast it will just bonk into this and fall back down.
cues.zh: 除非球速非常快，否则它只会撞上这个钢丝然后掉回去。

cues.en: Boo.
cues.zh: 真扫兴。

cues.en: The spinning target, while very different in its execution,
cues.zh: 旋转靶虽然实现方式大不相同，

cues.en: is similar to the rollover lanes.
cues.zh: 但原理和滚球感应轨道很像。

cues.en: The metal plate that the ball hits is attached to an eccentric axle,
cues.zh: 球撞击的金属板连在一个偏心轴上，

cues.en: I guess, and a wire linkage connected to the right hand side goes below the playfield through a small hole.
cues.zh: 应该是这样，右侧连接的一根连杆钢丝穿过小孔通到台面下方。

cues.en: When the target rotates,
cues.zh: 当靶板旋转时，

cues.en: that linkage is repeatedly pulled up and down which in turn pulls on a leaf switch, repeatedly connecting and disconnecting the two contacts as it spins.
cues.zh: 那根连杆就会被反复上下拉动，进而拉扯一个叶片开关，在旋转过程中不断接通和断开两个触点。

cues.en: When this target is hit just right, it's quite the show.
cues.zh: 只要击中这个靶的角度刚刚好，场面就相当精彩。

cues.en: But not quite the show that the pop bump... I mean jet bumpers can put on.
cues.zh: 但精彩程度还是比不上弹射……我是说喷射缓冲器（jet bumper）。

cues.en: Pioneered by Williams in 1948,
cues.zh: 这项技术由 Williams 于 1948 年首创，

cues.en: these jet bumpers repel the ball at high speed when they're hit.
cues.zh: 这些喷射缓冲器在被撞击时会高速将球弹飞。

cues.en: They're triggered by a circular platform known as the skirt.
cues.zh: 它们是由一个被称为“裙板”（skirt）的圆形托盘触发的。

cues.en: This is attached to a stick resting in a bowl below the playfield.
cues.zh: 裙板连着一根立柱，支承在台面下方的碗状托槽里。

cues.en: While rather silly at first glance,
cues.zh: 虽然乍看之下有点笨拙，

cues.en: this arrangement means that no matter where the ball should hit the skirt,
cues.zh: 但这种结构意味着无论球撞击裙板的哪个位置，

cues.en: the stick will pivot which in turn pushes the bowl downward
cues.zh: 立柱都会倾斜，进而向下推动托槽，

cues.en: thereby pushing these two switch contacts together.
cues.zh: 从而将这两个开关触点压合在一起。

cues.en: That provides power to the solenoid beneath the playfield which pulls down on this angled metal ring that floats above the skirt.
cues.zh: 这样就会为台面下方的电磁线圈供电，将悬浮在裙板上方带倾角的金属环向下拉动。

cues.en: When that occurs, the ball finds itself between that ring and the skirt.
cues.zh: 发生这种情况时，球恰好卡在金属环和裙板之间。

cues.en: Solenoids are quite fast so the ring immediately comes crashing down and makes contact with the ball.
cues.zh: 电磁线圈动作非常快，金属环瞬间砸落并撞击到球。

cues.en: Since the ring is angled at roughly 45 degrees, the ball gets flung away from the bumper.
cues.zh: 由于金属环有大约 45 度的倾角，球就会被猛烈弹离缓冲器。

cues.en: This is a very rough process and since the playfield is made of wood, a mylar protective sheet is installed around the bumper to minimize damage.
cues.zh: 这个撞击过程非常剧烈，而且由于台面是木质的，缓冲器周围会贴一层 Mylar 保护薄膜以尽量减少损伤。

cues.en: This wasn't always standard practice though so many older games exhibit severe wear around the bumpers.
cues.zh: 不过以前这并不是标准做法，所以很多老式机台在缓冲器周围都有严重的磨损痕迹。

cues.en: If you noticed the second switch down below the jet bumper,
cues.zh: 如果你注意到了喷射缓冲器下方的第二个开关，

cues.en: that is what actually registers points.
cues.zh: 那才是真正用来计分的开关。

cues.en: It's just like the targets we've been looking at, but hidden away and activated by the movement of the bumper ring and not the ball itself.
cues.zh: 它和我们刚才看到的靶位开关类似，只不过被藏了起来，并且是由缓冲环的机械动作触发，而不是球本身。

cues.en: Not all games work like this though. Sometimes a pop bumper relay is used activated by the skirt which locks on in a similar fashion to the points relays we looked at earlier.
cues.zh: 但并非所有机台都这样运作。有时会使用由裙板激活的缓冲器继电器，其自锁方式与我们之前讲过的计分继电器类似。

cues.en: A contact within that pop bumper relay awards points,
cues.zh: 缓冲器继电器内部的一个触点负责计分，

cues.en: and this switch serves as an end of stroke switch to release the relay after the bumper has fired.
cues.zh: 而这个开关则作为行程终点开关，在缓冲器触发弹射完毕后释放继电器。

cues.en: That approach has pros and cons, and Williams opted to power the solenoid directly from the bumper skirt switch.
cues.zh: 这种做法有利有弊，Williams 选择直接用缓冲器裙边开关给电磁铁供电。

cues.en: The main downside of this approach is that occasionally the ball will just brush against the bumper so it kinda sorta half fires
cues.zh: 这种方法的主要缺点是，球偶尔只是擦过缓冲器，结果它勉勉强强算半触发

cues.en: and it doesn't award points.
cues.zh: 而且不会计分。

cues.en: And finally we have the slingshots.
cues.zh: 最后是弹弓。

cues.en: These dastardly things are hardly a target worth hitting as they only score 10 points and they have a nasty habit of flinging the ball right into the out lanes.
cues.zh: 这些讨厌的家伙几乎不值得当作目标来打，因为它们只值 10 分，还总爱把球直接甩进外侧出球道。

cues.en: They're made up of three posts arranged in a triangle with a large rubber ring stretched across all three.
cues.zh: 它们由三根立柱排成三角形，并在三者之间绷着一大圈橡胶环。

cues.en: In the center of the long edge is a kicker just behind the rubber ring.
cues.zh: 长边中心、橡胶环正后方有一个弹射器。

cues.en: The kicker is flanked on either side by two switch contacts.
cues.zh: 弹射器两侧各有一个开关触点。

cues.en: When the ball hits the rubber ring and either of those switches close, power is sent to a solenoid below which pushes the kicker outward stretching the rubber ring and flinging the ball away.
cues.zh: 当球撞到橡胶环、且其中任一开关闭合时，电流会送到下方的电磁铁，把弹射器向外推，撑开橡胶环并把球弹开。

cues.en: Just like the pop bumpers, it's a switch below the playfield that actually registers points when the kicker has moved, and the switches behind the rubber only provide power to the solenoid.
cues.zh: 和弹出式缓冲器一样，真正在弹射器移动后计分的是台面下方的一个开关；橡胶环后面的开关只负责给电磁铁供电。

cues.en: Oh, right. I forgot about the kickback lane here.
cues.zh: 哦对，我忘了这里的回弹道。

cues.en: This thing is sort of a combo of the slingshot kicker and a rollover lane.
cues.zh: 这东西有点像弹弓弹射器和滚过道的结合。

cues.en: The ball lands on a trip flyer and after points are awarded, a solenoid below the playfield fires which bonks the ball back up.
cues.zh: 球落在一个触发开关上，计分后，台面下方的电磁铁会启动，把球顶回去。

cues.en: An interesting twist with this machine is that the pop bumpers and the slingshot solenoids
cues.zh: 这台机器一个有趣的特别之处是，弹出式缓冲器和弹弓的电磁铁

cues.en: are provided with DC power.
cues.zh: 由直流电供电。

cues.en: A bridge rectifier and capacitor are attached to the underside of the playfield,
cues.zh: 台面下方装有一个桥式整流器和一个电容器，

cues.en: which means that there is in fact a single semiconductor
cues.zh: 这意味着实际上只有一个半导体器件

cues.en: in this machine.
cues.zh: 在这台机器里。

cues.en: Or four, depending on how you wanna define things. It turns out that solenoids powered by DC can be stronger than AC powered ones,
cues.zh: 或者四个，取决于你怎么定义。事实证明，直流供电的电磁铁能比交流供电的更强，

cues.en: and Williams began tinkering with them around this time.
cues.zh: 而 Williams 大约在这个时候开始尝试使用它们。

cues.en: Only the pop bumpers and slingshots are powered through the rectifier though as you can see in the schematic.
cues.zh: 不过，从电路图可以看到，只有弹出式缓冲器和弹弓是通过整流器供电的。

cues.en: Everything else, including the flippers, is powered by 24 volts AC.
cues.zh: 其他所有部件，包括挡板，都由 24 伏交流电供电。

cues.en: And why don't we talk about the flippers?
cues.zh: 那不如聊聊挡板？

cues.en: As with pretty much everything that moves,
cues.zh: 和几乎所有会动的东西一样，

cues.en: they're powered by a solenoid,
cues.zh: 它们由电磁铁驱动，

cues.en: but in this case they're controlled by the player with buttons on the sides of the cabinet.
cues.zh: 但在这里，它们由玩家通过机柜侧面的按钮控制。

cues.en: Those buttons simply push the contacts of a leaf switch together which sends power to the flipper coils,
cues.zh: 这些按钮只是把簧片开关的触点压合，从而给挡板线圈供电，

cues.en: then they pull on a linkage and the flipper bat pops up.
cues.zh: 然后它们拉动连杆，挡板就弹起来。

cues.en: Flipper coils, though, are unique.
cues.zh: 不过，挡板线圈很特别。

cues.en: See, a strong solenoid needs quite a lot of power.
cues.zh: 要知道，强力的电磁铁需要相当大的功率。

cues.en: That means they get hot over time.
cues.zh: 这意味着它们会随时间发热。

cues.en: For every other solenoid in the machine, that's not much of a problem because they're only activated in short bursts.
cues.zh: 对机器里其他每个电磁铁来说，这不算大问题，因为它们只会短时间启动。

cues.en: But the flippers are controlled by the player,
cues.zh: 但挡板是由玩家控制的，

cues.en: and that player might just want to hold the flippers up in order to catch the ball.
cues.zh: 而玩家可能只是想一直抬起挡板来接住球。

cues.en: That could cause the coils to overheat,
cues.zh: 这会导致线圈过热，

cues.en: and coils that overheat tend to get melty,
cues.zh: 而过热的线圈往往会熔化，

cues.en: then smoky,
cues.zh: 然后冒烟，

cues.en: and on rare occasions,
cues.zh: 在极少数情况下，

cues.en: fiery.
cues.zh: 还会起火。

cues.en: Slow blow fuses throughout the cabinet should prevent a serious problem like a fire in the event that a coil becomes locked on, which can happen,
cues.zh: 机箱各处的慢熔保险丝应该能防止线圈持续通电时发生火灾这类严重问题，而这种情况是可能发生的，

cues.en: but we want the flippers to be able to stay up without causing any trouble.
cues.zh: 但我们希望挡板能一直保持抬起，而不引发任何问题。

cues.en: So, if you look carefully at the flipper coil, you'll see that it has three terminals.
cues.zh: 所以，仔细看挡板线圈，你会看到它有三个接线端子。

cues.en: The long coil of wire that actually makes the solenoid has a connection in its middle which allows it to function at two power levels.
cues.zh: 真正构成电磁铁的那段长线圈，在中间有一个接点，使它能以两种功率级别工作。

cues.en: When the flipper is at rest, the button sends power to the coil through the center tap.
cues.zh: 当挡板静止时，按钮通过中心抽头给线圈供电。

cues.en: This bypasses
cues.zh: 这会绕过

cues.en: half of the coil's length reducing the number of turns of wire that current flows through which makes the solenoid more powerful.
cues.zh: 线圈长度的一半，减少电流流过的导线匝数，从而使电磁铁更有力。

cues.en: That might seem backwards but that's just how solenoids work.
cues.zh: 这看起来可能有点反直觉，但电磁铁就是这样工作的。

cues.en: But once it reaches the end of its travel it opens this switch, another end of stroke switch.
cues.zh: 但一旦它到达行程终点，就会打开这个开关，也就是另一个行程末端开关。

cues.en: That removes power from the center tap, meaning current must now travel through the entire length of the solenoid wire.
cues.zh: 这会切断中心抽头的供电，意味着电流现在必须流过整段电磁铁导线。

cues.en: This reduces the current flowing through and the strength of the solenoid and allows it to stay energized without burning up.
cues.zh: 这会降低流过的电流和电磁铁的吸力，让它能保持通电而不烧毁。

cues.en: And for a demonstration of this principle,
cues.zh: 为了演示这个原理，

cues.en: observe the change in sound as I force the flipper bat down while holding in the button.
cues.zh: 在我按住按钮的同时强行把挡板压下去，听声音的变化。

cues.en: The lights in the machine even dim while I do this. It's a lot of current.
cues.zh: 我这样做时，机器里的灯甚至会变暗。电流很大。

cues.en: At this point we've looked at how everything on the playfield works, we've seen how the machine shows you your score,
cues.zh: 到这里，我们已经看了游戏台面上所有东西是如何工作的，也看到了机器如何显示你的分数，

cues.en: and we've seen how points get added to it.
cues.zh: 以及分数是如何加上去的。

cues.en: But the machine is doing a heck of a lot more than simply adding point values together,
cues.zh: 但这台机器做的远不只是把分值相加，

cues.en: which you might have been able to tell by all the stuff inside.
cues.zh: 从里面所有这些装置你大概也能看出来。

cues.en: There are layers and layers of complexity
cues.zh: 这里有一层又一层复杂性

cues.en: built atop the basic scoring functions.
cues.zh: 建立在基本计分功能之上。

cues.en: For instance, the machine has to know how to count.
cues.zh: 比如，机器必须知道如何计数。

cues.en: You get three balls per game and then it ends.
cues.zh: 每局你有三个球，然后游戏结束。

cues.en: It also needs to know how many players there are and change which set of score reels is active after each ball, but also not do that if the current player scored an extra ball and gets to shoot again.
cues.zh: 它还需要知道有多少玩家，并在每个球后切换哪组分数滚轮处于活动状态，但如果当前玩家得了额外球并可以再打一球，就不能切换。

cues.en: Then there's the bonus ladder I referenced earlier which always starts at 5,000 points but can be advanced when you hit certain targets in increments of 5,000.
cues.zh: 然后是之前提到的奖励阶梯，它总是从 5,000 分开始，但当你击中某些目标时，可以以 5,000 分为增量推进。

cues.en: And I think that's a good place to move to next.
cues.zh: 我觉得接下来很适合讲这个。

cues.en: The number five.
cues.zh: 数字五。

cues.en: Here. Watch this.
cues.zh: 这里。看好了。

cues.en: How on earth do you suppose that happened?
cues.zh: 你猜这到底是怎么发生的？

cues.en: I hit a switch just once,
cues.zh: 我只按了一次开关，

cues.en: but the score reel moved five times all on its own.
cues.zh: 但分数滚轮自己动了五次。

cues.en: Well, remember that ticking it was doing in the beginning?
cues.zh: 还记得一开始发出的那些滴答声吗？

cues.en: Perhaps you noticed it happened in groups of five.
cues.zh: 你可能注意到了，它们都是五个一组响的。

cues.en: Listen again.
cues.zh: 再听一次。

cues.en: Turns out the number five appears all over the place.
cues.zh: 原来，“5”这个数字无处不在。

cues.en: This target is worth 500 points, this lane scores 5,000
cues.zh: 这个靶子值 500 分，这条球道得 5,000 分，

cues.en: as does the kickback target,
cues.zh: 反弹靶也是 5,000 分，

cues.en: the bonus values increment in steps of 5,000 points,
cues.zh: 奖励分每次递增 5,000 分，

cues.en: and then there's this thing's name, Aztec.
cues.zh: 甚至连这台机器的名字——Aztec，

cues.en: That has five letters in it, and some of the targets will award points based on how many of those five letters are lit.
cues.zh: 也是五个字母，而且有些靶子会根据这五个字母点亮了几个来给分。

cues.en: How how is it doing all that? And why does everything happen in fives?
cues.zh: 它是怎么做到的？为什么所有事情都以 5 为单位？

cues.en: Well, it's time I introduce you to the score motor.
cues.zh: 那么，是时候向大家介绍计分电机（score motor）了。

cues.en: This wonky looking contraption is the closest thing this machine has to a central processing unit.
cues.zh: 这个看起来奇奇怪怪的装置，就是这台机器里最接近 CPU 的部件。

cues.en: The score motor consists of an electric motor which, through a speed reduction gearbox,
cues.zh: 计分电机包含一个电动机，它通过减速齿轮箱，

cues.en: slowly rotates a series of eight cams upon which rest a ridiculous
cues.zh: 缓慢带动一组共八个凸轮旋转，上面密密麻麻地

cues.en: number of switches in eight stacks.
cues.zh: 排列着八组开关，数量多得惊人。

cues.en: The stacks, from left to right, are called index one two three four five, impulse,
cues.zh: 从左到右，这几组分别叫做 index、1、2、3、4、5、impulse，

cues.en: and impulse forward.
cues.zh: 以及 impulse forward。

cues.en: Incidentally impulse forward just has a single switch which is used only in the reset sequence.
cues.zh: 顺便提一句，impulse forward 上只有一个开关，而且仅在复位序列中使用。

cues.en: Ah,
cues.zh: 啊，

cues.en: sequence.
cues.zh: 序列（sequence）。

cues.en: What a good word.
cues.zh: 这个词用得太好了。

cues.en: That is pretty much the whole idea of the score motor.
cues.zh: 这差不多就是计分电机的核心原理所在。

cues.en: It allows things to happen automatically in a sequence.
cues.zh: 它能让各种动作按序列自动发生。

cues.en: On every one of the eight cams there are a series of divots or bumps.
cues.zh: 八个凸轮中的每一个上，都有一组凹槽或凸起。

cues.en: These will actuate the switch stacks as the cam rotates.
cues.zh: 凸轮旋转时，就会触发对应的开关组。

cues.en: Either the stack will briefly fall into the divot and the switches within will make or break contact as they move,
cues.zh: 要么是开关组短暂落入凹槽，其中的开关随之闭合或断开；

cues.en: or in the case of the two impulse cams at the far right, a series of bumps will push up on the switch stack
cues.zh: 要么就像最右边那两个脉冲凸轮那样，由一系列凸起顶起开关组，

cues.en: which accomplishes the same thing.
cues.zh: 也能达到同样的效果。

cues.en: The cams one through five are all offset such that the switches they actuate will be bumped in sequence. One, two, three, four, five.
cues.zh: 1 到 5 号凸轮彼此错开，让它们触发的开关依次被顶起：1、2、3、4、5。

cues.en: And impulse and impulse forward are bumped five times with every rotation.
cues.zh: 而 impulse 和 impulse forward 每转一圈都会被顶起五次。

cues.en: The index cam on the far left is critical for the score motor's functions.
cues.zh: 最左边的 index 凸轮对计分电机的运转至关重要。

cues.en: The switch on the top of this stack is the motor run switch.
cues.zh: 这一组最上面的开关是电机运行开关。

cues.en: It's much like the self powering interlocks we've been looking at in other relays.
cues.zh: 它很像我们在其他继电器中见过的自锁结构。

cues.en: When closed it provides power to the motor and thus it will run, and crucially that switch is closed whenever the motor is out of its parked position.
cues.zh: 闭合时它会给电机供电使其运转；最关键的是，只要电机离开停机位置，该开关就一直闭合。

cues.en: Once it gets back to the parked position the switch stack falls into the divot, that switch opens, and the motor stops.
cues.zh: 一旦回到停机位置，开关组落入凹槽，开关断开，电机便停了下来。

cues.en: In practice, this means that if anything should cause the motor to start moving,
cues.zh: 在实际运作中，这意味着只要有任何动作启动了电机，

cues.en: it will keep itself moving until it's made a complete cycle.
cues.zh: 它就会自己保持运转，直到转满一个完整的周期。

cues.en: It even works if I just push on it.
cues.zh: 哪怕我只是用手推它一下，也会这样。

cues.en: But you'll notice that when I did that,
cues.zh: 但你会注意到，当我推它的时候，

cues.en: nothing happened.
cues.zh: 什么都没有发生。

cues.en: This is what's both very confusing and completely critical to understand about electromechanical
cues.zh: 理解这类机电系统，

cues.en: systems like this.
cues.zh: 有一点既让人十分困惑，又极其关键。

cues.en: With the exception of the motor run switch,
cues.zh: 除了电机运转开关之外，

cues.en: the rest of these switches aren't connected to anything even when the game is on and in play.
cues.zh: 其余开关哪怕在游戏开机游玩时，也没有连接到任何地方。

cues.en: They're just
cues.zh: 它们只是

cues.en: there
cues.zh: 待在那儿，

cues.en: clicking away without accomplishing a thing because the wires they're connected to hit dead ends.
cues.zh: 啪嗒啪嗒响个不停却毫无作用，因为相连的线路都是死路。

cues.en: It takes two to tango, and to make something happen the machine performs a dance where it constantly rewires itself on the fly.
cues.zh: 孤掌难鸣，为了触发动作，机器必须实时动态重连线路。

cues.en: And what does it use to make that happen?
cues.zh: 那它是靠什么实现的呢？

cues.en: That's right,
cues.zh: 没错，

cues.en: relays.
cues.zh: 继电器。

cues.en: That's why there are so many of them in this machine.
cues.zh: 这就是为什么机器里有这么多继电器。

cues.en: To actually make something occur
cues.zh: 要真正触发动作，

cues.en: you need a relay to connect these bouncing switches to other things in the machine, that way they'll,
cues.zh: 就得用继电器把这些跳动的开关连接到其他部件上，这样它们才能……

cues.en: you know, do stuff.
cues.zh: 你懂的，发挥作用。

cues.en: Take this rollover worth 5,000 points as an example.
cues.zh: 以这个 5000 分的过球开关为例。

cues.en: You'll never guess what the 5,000
cues.zh: 你绝对猜不到这个 5000 分

cues.en: rollover switch completes a circuit to.
cues.zh: 过球开关连通的是什么电路。

cues.en: It's none other than the 5,000 relay which lives on the underside of the playfield.
cues.zh: 正是位于台面下方的 5000 分继电器。

cues.en: This relay has three switch contacts which all connect to the score motor.
cues.zh: 这个继电器有三组触点，全都连接到计分电机。

cues.en: The switch on the right sends power to the motor to start it turning which you can observe when I bridge the contacts.
cues.zh: 右边的开关给电机供电让它开始转动，我短接触点时大家就能看到。

cues.en: The switch on the left is yet another relay interlock.
cues.zh: 左边的开关则是另一个继电器自锁触点。
